as index split runner,count,ratio,clean,nothing,empty,none,tests,test/a.bats,status,reads,test/b.bats,a\040"quoted"\040key:\040with.dots,text,unicode ,
len @index
as m from_strt map/map.strt $index
type @m
len @m
string @m .clean
string @m .ratio
get @m .tests
string @m ."a \"quoted\" key: with.dots"
to_strt @m $index
as odd set @m .k 0.:blob=x
to_strt @odd $index
as short split runner,count ,
from_strt map/map.strt $short
as none arr
from_strt map/map.strt $none
as ints arr 0.:int=1
from_strt map/map.strt $ints
as s str x
from_strt map/map.strt $s
to_strt @m $short
to_strt @m $s
as e arr
to_strt @e $index
from_strt reads/reads.silt $index
from_strt bool/bool.strt $index
from_strt code/code.strt $index
from_strt key/key.strt $index
